interpretation.meaning: These are separate version axes. Placement version 15 / density 14 / packing 1 is not packing version 4.

decisionBoundary.currentMode: RB56 current-15 normal census retains placementPackingVersion=1 and has no packing-probe receipt.
decisionBoundary.packing4: A distinct constraint option that gates connected-vacancy compaction plus one post-selection route probe. It is not registered as an RB56 placement-version profile.
decisionBoundary.optIn: No packing4 opt-in, new call path, budget increase, model change, or metric/oracle relaxation is recorded or authorized by this audit.
decisionBoundary.density10Packing4: The constraints constructor accepts density 10 with packing version 4 as a type-valid tuple, but Rb56Placement does not register that tuple. It cannot be represented as unchanged placement version 10, 11, or 12; the generation dependency canonical records non-default packing identity.
decisionBoundary.replayInterpretation: The reported replay match is evidence about the packing-mode gap if a new mode is introduced. It does not establish a bug in the current packing-1 path.

currentPacking4Flow.selectedSource: The already selected routed incumbent for the same generation request.
beforeAdditionalRoute: PcbPlacementCompactor.compact applies existing strip compaction and, for packing version 4, connected-vacancy compaction.
PcbPlacementCompactor.compactPairedVacancies applies the existing connected-pair candidate and rechecks strips.
No additional route is made if the compacted plan is geometrically identical to the source.
currentPacking4Flow.probe: At most one additional P07 route request after selection, using the same board and remaining request ledger. The original routed incumbent is fingerprint-checked and retained unless the new routed candidate passes the strict metric comparison.
currentPacking4Flow.metricSelection: A candidate is selected only when area is strictly smaller and copper length, via count, and protected-void count are each no greater than the same-request incumbent. Ties and any regression keep the incumbent.
currentPacking4Flow.metricLimit: This compares the candidate only to that request's selected incumbent. It does not enforce an inequality between different placement versions or profiles.

mediumPlacement.source: Six planner calls are collected before routing; the route subset is then capped at three.

optionalProbe.headroomRule: The generator checks required ordering and residual expansion headroom, then passes min(P07 request maximum, remaining medium ledger) to the route request.

evidenceLimits: This packet is a source-boundary audit plus root-supplied observations; it is not a new gate result.
PcbPackingMetrics proves same-request incumbent retention under its four metrics; it does not prove cross-version or cross-profile area monotonicity.
A density-10 / packing-4 configuration would be a distinct generation identity, not evidence that current density-10 or density-11 behavior was already using the compactor/probe.
The reported W observations do not establish root cause or global bounds for all seeds.
